name: Stanisław Wyspiański
bio: Stanisław Mateusz Ignacy Wyspiański was a Polish playwright, painter, poet, and interior and furniture designer. A patriotic writer, he created symbolic national dramas accordant with the artistic premises of the Young Poland movement.

portraitCredit.author: Koncern Ilustrowany Kurier Codzienny - Archiwum Ilustracji, sygnatura: 1-K-1939a-4
